newsletter.subject: Pinecrest's Driftwood earbuds: first look
newsletter.text:
**Pinecrest Audio** announced the Driftwood earbuds today. 🎧

- Price: $129
- Battery: 9 hours, 30 with the case
- Ships: January 20

In our short hands-on, noise cancelling was good but not class-leading, and the case is noticeably smaller than last year's model. Pinecrest says the buds are rated for sweat and rain.

[Pre-order here](https://gadgetgrove.example/driftwood)

referenceSummary: Pinecrest Audio announced the Driftwood earbuds, priced at $129, with 9 hours of battery or 30 with the case, shipping January 20. In a short hands-on, noise cancelling was good but not class-leading, and the case is smaller than last year's.
